items.title: Charles Schwab expands crypto access with Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Charles Schwab's (SCHW) addition of Solana (SOL-USD), Avalanche (AVAX-USD) and Chainlink (LINK-USD) to its spot trading platform, expanding the crypto assets available to investors. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
